roadmap.title: Play the story and collect along the way
roadmap.description: Clear Chapters 1-8 in one playthrough. Pick up Tablet Shards, Visions, early cave masters and the first Colosseum league as you go, and rotate each Vision once it reaches max mastery rank. Mechabo upgrades, party members and the airship come with the story.

roadmap.title: Free-roam cleanup
roadmap.description: After the story, the whole world stays open. Finish substories, the remaining cave masters, Visions, espers, Colosseum leagues, Legendary Arms and Adamantite, then the Dragon's Maw island for King Gil Snapper and Metal Gigantuar.

roadmap.title: Ultima Weapon and counters
roadmap.description: Fight Ultima Weapon with a strong, fully mastered party. Use a short grind to finish the Resonance counter, then collect the final achievement.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in the game.

steps.text: Unlock the other 39 achievements; this one unlocks on its own when the last of them pops.
Play through Chapter 1 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 2 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 3 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 4 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 5 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 6 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 7 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed.
Play through Chapter 8 until it ends. The achievement unlocks on the clear and cannot be missed. It is the final chapter.

achievements.summary: Have all eight party members join your team.

steps.text: Keep playing the story. Rain and Lasswell start with you, and Fina, Lid, Nichol, Jake, Sakura and Archwitch Fina join one by one by Chapter 5.

achievements.summary: Complete the substory of each of the eight party members.

guide.context: Each substory is a sub quest marked on the map with a blue exclamation mark. They open between Chapters 5 and 8, so the last ones wait until late in the story or free roaming. Each one gives the character a permanent stat bonus.

collectibles.name: Rain: A New Leaf
collectibles.method: Talk to Rain on the airship deck and finish the quest.

collectibles.name: Lasswell: The Twin Titleholders
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.

collectibles.name: Fina: Shimmering Reflections
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.

collectibles.name: Lid: Beyond the Blue
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.

collectibles.name: Jake: Token Legacy
collectibles.method: Sleep at an inn, then go to the capital and accept the quest. If it is not there yet, play further into the story and sleep at an inn again.
collectibles.note: Finishing this also helps start the Amelia Vision quest.

collectibles.name: Nichol: Nichol's Duty
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.
collectibles.note: It also gives the Leviathan esper.

collectibles.name: Sakura: Mysidia, Ever Blooming
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.

collectibles.name: Archwitch Fina: Last Respite
collectibles.method: Accept the marked quest in town and finish it.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, follow the story to the @loc{Village of Kol}. You get the chocobo there.
Play through Chapter 4. The airship is given to you at the start of Chapter 5.

achievements.description: Clear all Fledgling League fights in the Colosseum.
achievements.summary: Win all five Fledgling League fights in the Colosseum.

steps.text: After Chapter 4 begins, go to @loc{Grandshelt, the Royal Capital} and leave by the west exit to reach the Colosseum.
Sign up at the leftmost, green table (Fledgling League) and win all five fights. They are level 25 to 32.
steps.note: Fight 2 gives an Adamantite, fight 3 an Ancient Greatsword and fight 5 the Gaia Hammer. Keep all of them.

steps.text: Make a manual save before each fight and do not load a save during it, or a one-time prize may not be given.

achievements.description: Clear all Brawler League fights in the Colosseum.
achievements.summary: Win all five Brawler League fights in the Colosseum.

steps.text: In the Colosseum, sign up at the blue table, second from the left (Brawler League), and win all five fights. They are level 40 to 48.
steps.note: Fights 2 and 3 each give an Adamantite and fight 5 gives the Ancient Cuirass.

steps.text: Make a manual save before each fight and do not load a save during it, or a one-time prize may not be given.

achievements.description: Clear all Gladiator League fights in the Colosseum.
achievements.summary: Win all five Gladiator League fights in the Colosseum.

steps.text: In the Colosseum, sign up at the purple table, third from the left (Gladiator League), and win all five fights. They are level 55 to 70.

achievements.description: Receive a reward at Oblivion Palace for the first time.
achievements.summary: Get your first chest reward from the Enigmatic Princess in Oblivion Palace.

guide.context: Chest thresholds are running totals of all shards handed in, not per visit: 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 20, 24 and 28 shards open the next chest in the 1-Star Chamber.

steps.text: Collect 3 Tablet Shards. The first three are in the Royal Capital, the Village of Kol and the Town of Felicitas, all in Chapter 1.
Go to @loc{Oblivion Palace}, just east of @loc{Grandport Harbour}, and talk to the @npc{Enigmatic Princess}. Hand over your shards.
Go into the 1-Star Chamber (the first treasure room) and open its first chest, Chest I. It holds the @item{Vitality Charm}, and opening it unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Help the enigmatic princess regain her second memory.
achievements.summary: Give the Enigmatic Princess enough Tablet Shards to restore her second memory.

guide.context: Bring shards to the @npc{Enigmatic Princess} inside @loc{Oblivion Palace} (just east of Grandport Harbour). Hand in at least 64 shards so the memory plays. There are 99 in the world and none are missable, but 89 is the most any achievement needs. If the memory scene plays and the achievement does not pop, restart the game and reload your save.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 1
collectibles.method: In the Commercial District, take the east path from the main entrance. It is left of the weapon and item stalls, among crates.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 2
collectibles.method: Beside the pool in the south-west corner, on its left.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 3
collectibles.method: Cross the east wooden bridge. It is just right of the stone wall ahead.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 4
collectibles.method: Cross the west wooden bridge and turn left at the torch to find a hidden path. Climb the ladder and look behind the wall on the left.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 5
collectibles.method: Enter the second area and descend the steps; it sits behind two grey-green cylinders.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 6
collectibles.method: After the bridge collapses and you win the fight, climb the ladder and the next stairs. It is behind the fallen stone pillar just below.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 7
collectibles.method: Walk onto the wooden pier south of the Item Shop; barrels on the right hide it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 8
collectibles.method: Just west of the Weapon and Armour shop, at the base of a tree.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 9
collectibles.method: Hidden by the stalagmite at the cave's far end.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 10
collectibles.method: After the fountain, go up the stairs on the right. It is on the edge of the ledge.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 11
collectibles.method: Once you finish the stairs of the first main area, walk to the tip of the right-hand ledge before entering the room.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 12
collectibles.method: In the next room, climb the stairs and go left to the end of a visible ledge.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 13
collectibles.method: In the first side area on the left, by the NPC and the shut gate with electric lights. It is in the corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 14
collectibles.method: A stack of wooden crates at the main area's second crossroads (noticeboard to the west, shops to the east) hides it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 15
collectibles.method: Go up the first stairs, then up the stairs left of the main platform. It is at the end of that path, next to the ladder.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 16
collectibles.method: Go up the first stairs, then down the stairs right of the main platform. It is beside the third metal girder.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 17
collectibles.method: On the harder path (do not pay Lid 1,000 gil), it is in plain sight round the corner after the yellowish tree of the "Elven Maven" sub quest.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 18
collectibles.method: Take the easy route, which costs 1,000 gil paid to Lid at the entrance. Climb the long ladder and follow the trail to a tree; the shard lies beside it.
collectibles.note: You can switch paths later by teleporting back to the dungeon entrance from the save point.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 19
collectibles.method: Exit the dungeon to the world map, walk south beyond the Shrine of Zidane and circle round to the upper entrance. Take the short stone ramp down; rocks hide it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 20
collectibles.method: In the south-west of the main area, cross the wooden bridge and head south to the end of the path.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 21
collectibles.method: In the north-west, go down the steps to the arena where you fight Mom Bomb. It is south of the path.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 22
collectibles.method: Head west in the first area. It is behind some crates.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 23
collectibles.method: Ride the first lift, then go east through the fence gap to the generator area. In the south-east corner, climb down the ladder and walk west.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 24
collectibles.method: After the second lift, go north. It is behind the shipping container just before the fenced lift area.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 25
collectibles.method: In the first room, ignore the elevator with the four green crystals beside it and look behind the right-hand pillar.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 26
collectibles.method: A few elevators further on, an elevator stands above a staircase. The shard is wedged between the stairs and the railing on their right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 27
collectibles.method: From the previous shard go south and take the next crystal elevator across. It is on the left of the platform.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 28
collectibles.method: Right at the entrance, next to the boat-tour NPC, just right of the central platform.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 29
collectibles.method: In the middle of the city, straight north of the previous shard, is a pool with two statues. Look by the bench behind the left statue.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 30
collectibles.method: Head north-east from the statue pool, past the giant water wheel, to a stone bridge. The shard is hidden by a plant pot standing midway across.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 31
collectibles.method: From the statue pool go north up some steps. It is behind the tree.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 32
collectibles.method: On the story path after the boat maze, at the far dock. It is just to the left.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 33
collectibles.method: After the long boat maze, go through a door to the save point and ladder room. It is in front of a waterfall.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 34
collectibles.method: After the story returns you here, a hidden path opens in the room left of the entrance. Climb two ladders along the narrow path.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 35
collectibles.method: In the second room (the room after the save point on a revisit), go up the stairs and east, next to the ladder.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 36
collectibles.method: In the large waterfall room, on one of the stone platforms.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 37
collectibles.method: In the same room, go north over the wooden bridges. It is on a rock between the waterfalls.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 38
collectibles.method: By a well on a little grassy island, south of the shops for weapons and items.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 39
collectibles.method: Go north from the Item Shop to the foot of the long bridge; it is by a tree on the right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 40
collectibles.method: Lower the water in the room with a round middle platform and four paths in a cross shape, then take the stairs on the north side down.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 41
collectibles.method: Where several water-level crystals stand, sail the boat north-east beyond the balcony holding the Viridian Pot enemy. A ledge on the right has the shard.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 42
collectibles.method: After lowering the water more and descending, it is just left of the bottom of a long ladder.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 43
collectibles.method: In the south-west corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 44
collectibles.method: Right beside the eastern staircase and entrance.
collectibles.note: Entering via the southern world-map approach puts you right beside it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 45
collectibles.method: In Castle Plaza, directly east of the tram stop.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 46
collectibles.method: In the Residential District, in the south-east corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 47
collectibles.method: In the Slums, just east of where you arrive, next to barrels.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 48
collectibles.method: Go east to a metal walkway and down the stairs. Turn back west and down a small ramp, then south to the room corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 49
collectibles.method: Go deeper and head south, passing the Pot enemy's room. A hidden way beneath the metal bridge climbs to a room on the right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 50
collectibles.method: In the north-west, go right of Jake's room (the door with two flags) and behind it to a hidden path. Climb the ladder, then walk a few steps south-west.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 51
collectibles.method: In the north-east, from the conference-room exit go up the stairs on the right. It is behind a metal pillar by the railing.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 52
collectibles.method: In the main lava-floor area, travel to the far west and climb the stairs and platforms to a crystal switch. Hit it, walk over the girder that rises, then turn left.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 53
collectibles.method: Use the long ladder beside the save point. Turn the left-hand switch three times, then go north and take the second turning on the left.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 54
collectibles.method: After you get the Master Key, go south to another cell room. It is in the first cell on the right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 55
collectibles.method: With the Master Key in hand, go back to the first prison room and unlock the cell along its west wall.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 56
collectibles.method: Two horse statues flank the stairs to the throne room. It is behind the left one.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 57
collectibles.method: Up the throne-room stairs, take the right hallway and the first door. It is in the south-east corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 58
collectibles.method: Follow the first path to its far western end. You can only enter the Colosseum from Chapter 4, via the capital's west exit.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 59
collectibles.method: Past the main entrance, descend the right-hand stairs to the teleport crystal. The shard is in the corner, with an NPC standing in front of it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 60
collectibles.method: Visit the Storefront area. The shard is by two crates straight south of the Weapon Shop.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 61
collectibles.method: Walk west beyond the Item Shop and step into the blue teleporter. In the circular fountain area, look at the second pillar to your right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 62
collectibles.method: In the first room after the blue portal, check the south-west, among the writing desks.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 63
collectibles.method: Just inside the village, two steps up between a bench and a pot.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 64
collectibles.method: At the village's north-eastern edge, beside a snowman in front of an igloo.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 65
collectibles.method: In the first room, go as far west as possible. It is next to a fallen pillar.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 66
collectibles.method: In the second area, descend the stairs just below the save point to a fallen chandelier; the shard is beside it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 67
collectibles.method: In the last room, where the second save point is, go up the ladder on the east side, then follow the balcony round to the west.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 68
collectibles.method: Just left of the large padlocked gate, under a chain.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 69
collectibles.method: West of the gate, go into the tent furthest west, above Sol's position. Crates in its upper-right corner hide the shard.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 70
collectibles.method: Right after the cutscene that opens the gate's first padlock, head to the far side of the third area to the west. It lies in a clearing.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 71
collectibles.method: Go to the top of the main entrance and climb the stairs behind the big crystal.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 72
collectibles.method: Keep climbing the spiral staircase. It is on a landing.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 73
collectibles.method: Further up, on a landing along the story route, short of the Azure Pot enemy.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 74
collectibles.method: Higher again, in a snowdrift just past the Azure Pot on the story route.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 75
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge and go north to a small army camp. It is behind supplies in the bottom-right corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 76
collectibles.method: Beside the right wall of the house in the town's north-west end.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 77
collectibles.method: Using the Lvl 1 security card route (west): the room with desks and a green teleporter.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 78
collectibles.method: Same Lvl 1 route, in the room where three consoles must be switched on. It sits up on the shelves in the south-east corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 79
collectibles.method: Using the Lvl 2 security card route (east): cross the room of green teleporters, then take the long ladder up. The right-hand gantry holds the shard.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 80
collectibles.method: A short walk west of the first save point, beneath a dead tree.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 81
collectibles.method: East of the second save point and down a ramp, in the corner.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 82
collectibles.method: Up in the north of town, beside the eastern side of the entrance to the Weapon and Item Shop. The waterfall hides it.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 83
collectibles.method: Leave the first room: it lies on the landing's southern end, before the two stairways down.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 84
collectibles.method: Go down the west stairs and south to the end, then take the east path. It is on a staircase blocked by a fallen pillar.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 85
collectibles.method: Continue on the story route past the last shard and descend a long ladder. Walk west, ascend a ladder running alongside, then head south to another broken pillar.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 86
collectibles.method: Starting at the second save point, pass through the north door into the wide room with the tombstone about blades and magic. Behind the north stairs, turn east into a hidden room beneath the torch, go up the stairs and then up the ladder by the Violet Pot enemy. The shard is at the top.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 87
collectibles.method: Begin at the third save point and ladder up to the crystal-elevator room. Ride the third elevator, grab the shard, and only then ride the fourth.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 88
collectibles.method: Head east past the item shop. It is under a blossom tree.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 89
collectibles.method: From the first save point, follow the story path to a ramp crossroads. Take the down path.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 90
collectibles.method: Continue along the story route to a platform linking two wooden bridges, beside two pines.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 91
collectibles.method: Under a tree on the western edge.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 92
collectibles.method: On a bend of the story route, north from the first save point.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 93
collectibles.method: At a dead end south-west from the second save point.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 94
collectibles.method: Take the left branch at the first fork beyond the save point, on the story route.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 95
collectibles.method: Further along the story path, beside some stones after a cutscene.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 96
collectibles.method: Follow the main path from the entrance and take the right at the first fork.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 97
collectibles.method: After the previous shard, take the left at the next fork, then the next right.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 98
collectibles.method: In the area where see-through bridges appear as you approach, go straight north from the third solid platform, then west along the bridge.

collectibles.name: Tablet Shard 99
collectibles.method: Close to the dungeon's finish, in the area of the Rogue Magitek Armour fight.

steps.text: Buy weapons, armour, accessories and items in shops as you progress. All spending adds up.
If you hold 100,000 gil and the achievement has not popped, make a manual save, spend it all, then reload.
Keep exploring and winning battles. The total counts all gil you earn, so you do not need to hold it all at once.
If you are still short, defeat King Gil Snapper repeatedly, or equip the Vaan Vision at Lv 9 (its Double Gil ability doubles gil after battles).
In Chapter 1, go to Marauder Cave, east of @loc{Siren's Tower}. The recommended level is 15.
Walk up to the @enemy{Marauder} inside the cave, interact with it and win the fight.

guide.context: Any five cave masters count. These are the first five you can reach; each cave is named after its master. Visit a cave once to fast travel there later.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Marauder} (Chapter 1, level 15), @enemy{Shoggoth} (Chapter 2, level 25), @enemy{Rukh} (Chapter 3, level 26), @enemy{Mindflayer} (Chapter 3, level 28) and @enemy{Gogmagog} (Chapter 4, level 34).

guide.context: Stand at a cave entrance to see its recommended level. Once the airship arrives in Chapter 5, every cave is reachable, so you can leave the high-level ones for later. Each master drops Magicite for awakening Visions.

collectibles.name: Marauder (level 15)
collectibles.location: Marauder Cave, east of Siren's Tower
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with the Marauder and win.

collectibles.name: Shoggoth (level 25)
collectibles.location: Shoggoth Cave, north of Mt. Thunderclap
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Shoggoth and win.

collectibles.name: Rukh (level 26)
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Rukh and win.

collectibles.name: Mindflayer (level 28)
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Mindflayer and win.

collectibles.name: Malboro Varietas (level 45)
collectibles.location: Malboro Varietas Cave, island north of Amore
collectibles.method: Fly there by airship, enter, interact with Malboro Varietas and win.

collectibles.name: Gogmagog (level 34)
collectibles.location: Gogmagog Cave, south-west of the Rebel Hideout
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Gogmagog and win.

collectibles.name: Pyroviper (level 37)
collectibles.location: Pyroviper Cave, south of the Weapons Factory
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Pyroviper and win.

collectibles.name: Salome (level 39)
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Salome and win.

collectibles.name: Jotunn (level 42)
collectibles.location: Jotunn Cave, on the western island
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Jotunn and win.

collectibles.name: Catacumba (level 54)
collectibles.location: Catacumba Cave, on the south-east island
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Catacumba and win.

collectibles.name: Necromonarch (level 55)
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Necromonarch and win.

collectibles.name: Humbaba (level 55)
collectibles.location: Humbaba Cave, north-east tip of the continent
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Humbaba and win.

collectibles.name: Tartarosaurus (level 60)
collectibles.location: Tartarosaurus Cave, on the far east island
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Tartarosaurus and win.

collectibles.name: Titanoraidos (level 60)
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Titanoraidos and win.

collectibles.name: Malboro Menace (level 60)
collectibles.location: Malboro Menace Cave, on the northern continent
collectibles.method: Enter the cave, interact with Malboro Menace and win.

achievements.description: Win a fight against a King Gil Snapper.
achievements.summary: Win a fight against a King Gil Snapper.

steps.text: Once the Chapter 5 airship is yours, fly to the Kingdom of Pharm's southern tip and go into @loc{Dragon's Maw}. Fight your way through to the small forested island at the far end.
steps.note: The recommended level is 55 and the random fights are among the toughest in the game, so return later if you need to.

steps.text: Run around the island for random encounters until @enemy{King Gil Snapper} appears. The others are Metal Gigantuar and Gigantuar.
Defeat it with Ice attacks. It is level 49, takes damage from Ice, absorbs every other element and has very high physical defence.
steps.note: Bring magic users, or equip Visions that use Ice attacks.

achievements.displayName: The Weapon that Suits the User
achievements.description: Have Aileen craft a weapon for the first time.
achievements.summary: Have Aileen forge a weapon for any party member.

steps.text: During Chapter 5, complete the @loc{Dilmagia} sub quest "Forger of Wills" to bring Aileen aboard.
From Chapter 6, talk to @npc{Aileen} on the airship deck.
Give her one @item{Adamantite}, pick a party member and she forges that character's weapon.
steps.note: The easiest Adamantite is the prize for Fledgling Battle 2 in the Colosseum.

achievements.description: Have Aileen craft weapons for all party members.
achievements.summary: Have Aileen forge a weapon for all eight party members.

guide.context: Aileen forges one weapon per Adamantite, and there are exactly eight in the game. Recruit her by completing "Forger of Wills", a sub quest in Dilmagia, then talk to her on the airship deck from Chapter 6. Keep a manual save from before each of the three Colosseum fights and check your Adamantite count after each win.

collectibles.name: Fledgling Battle 2
collectibles.method: Win the second Fledgling League fight (level 27).

collectibles.name: Brawler Battle 2
collectibles.method: Win the second Brawler League fight (level 41).

collectibles.name: Brawler Battle 3
collectibles.method: Win the third Brawler League fight (level 43).

collectibles.name: 3-Star Chamber, fifth chest
collectibles.method: After handing in 80 shards in total, open Chest V of the 3-Star Chamber.

collectibles.name: 4-Star Chamber, first chest
collectibles.method: Once 89 shards in total are handed in, the first chest of the 4-Star Chamber holds it.

collectibles.name: Rugged Mountain Path
collectibles.method: Open the treasure chest on the main story route.

collectibles.name: North of Olderion
collectibles.method: Get the treasure radar from the Hiding Man in Gaberada, the Undertown, then scan the bay. Lid gives hot and cold hints.
collectibles.note: The man is behind the inn: take the hidden path down the stairs to the west.

collectibles.name: Merchant Ship
collectibles.method: Find a wandering Merchant Ship, hover over it with the airship, interact, and pay 35,000 gil for an Adamantite.
collectibles.note: If you cannot afford it, another ship spawns soon.

achievements.description: Obtain one of the Twelve Legendary Arms for the first time.
achievements.summary: Get any single Legendary Arm out of the twelve.

steps.text: Get any Ancient item. The quickest is the @item{Ancient Greatsword}, the prize for Fledgling Battle 3 in the Colosseum.
Fly the airship to the mountain island that lies between Dirnado and Gronoa. Land there and go into the @loc{Chamber of Arms}. Walk the corridor and step through the portal.
Interact with the glowing pedestal for your Ancient item and accept the trial. Defeat the level 50 enemy in both of its stages to receive the Legendary Arm.
steps.note: Come back later if the fight is too hard.

guide.context: Take each Ancient item to its glowing pedestal in the Chamber of Arms (a mountain island between Dirnado and Gronoa, reached by airship from Chapter 5) and win the two-stage level 50 trial. The item then becomes its Legendary Arm. The later level 75 trials are not needed. Make a manual save before each Colosseum fight and do not load a save during it.

achievements.description: Win a fight against a Metal Gigantuar.
achievements.summary: Win a fight against a Metal Gigantuar.

steps.text: Once the Chapter 5 airship is yours, fly to the Kingdom of Pharm's southern tip and go into @loc{Dragon's Maw}. Fight your way through to the small forested island at the far end.
steps.note: The recommended level is 55 and the random fights are among the toughest in the game, so return later if you need to.

steps.text: Run around the island for random encounters until @enemy{Metal Gigantuar} appears. The others are King Gil Snapper and Gigantuar.
Kill it: it has just 8 HP but evades almost everything and will flee sooner or later. Dualcast a powerful spell like Ultima to squeeze in extra turns.

achievements.description: Reach max Mastery Rank for a vision for the first time.
achievements.summary: Raise any Vision to Mastery Rank 9 on a character for the first time.

guide.context: Mastery Rank belongs to the Vision on that character. Later chapters give much more Mastery Rank points, so it goes faster as the story goes on.

steps.text: Equip a Vision on a party member in the menu.
Win battles with it equipped. Mastery Rank points from battles raise its Mastery Rank until it reaches 9.

achievements.description: Awaken a vision to its limit for the first time.
achievements.summary: Awaken any Vision to three stars for the first time.

steps.text: Get one Magicite Shard, one Magicite and one Magicite Cryst. They come from chests, enemies (cave masters especially), some Colosseum fights and sub quests. Crysts first appear in Chapter 5.
Talk to a @npc{Moogle of Light} (in almost every town and on the airship) and awaken one Vision step by step: a Shard gives one star, Magicite two, and a Cryst three.
Visit the Sanctums of Light on the map. Enter, touch the crystal and answer three questions about that Final Fantasy game. Any answers work.
Other Visions come from the story and from sub quests. Ten are available by the end of Chapter 3.

guide.context: No Vision is missable and all can be collected in free roam. Only Sephiroth must be fought. The rest come from a Sanctum of Light (enter, touch the crystal, answer three questions about that Final Fantasy game, any answers work) or from a story event or sub quest.

guide.context: Mastery Rank is tracked for each Vision on each character, unlike star awakening, which stays. Rotating Visions as they max out also gives more abilities and stat bonuses.

steps.text: Keep a Vision equipped on a character until it reaches Mastery Rank 9.
Switch that character to another Vision and repeat. Keep rotating until 8 Visions have reached Mastery Rank 9.
Gigantuar gives a lot of Mastery Rank points, and can be found on the island behind Dragon's Maw.

achievements.summary: Gain the help of three espers.

guide.context: Any three espers count. Fina and Archwitch Fina summon them in battle. These three are the earliest.

steps.text: Chapter 1: beat @enemy{Siren} at @loc{Siren's Tower} as part of the story.
Chapter 2: enter @loc{Mt. Thunderclap} by the upper path, south past the Shrine of Zidane. Examine the gravestone and defeat @enemy{Ramuh}.
Chapter 3: examine the gravestone in @loc{Ruby Cave}, collect the three Ruby Fragments in order, then return to the gravestone to get Carbuncle. There is no fight.
steps.note: The three fragment locations are listed under the Sovereigns of the Planet checklist.

achievements.summary: Gain the help of all nine espers.

guide.context: Espers are summoned by Fina and Archwitch Fina. All but Carbuncle must be beaten in battle. None are missable, but they are most useful if collected as you go.

guide.context: The game does not show a counter. Normal play often reaches 1,000; if you are still short, farm as described below.

steps.text: In normal battles, hit enemy weaknesses or use attacks marked with a bullet symbol to empty the yellow stagger bar under their health bar. Every stagger counts.
If you are still short late in the game, farm Resonance fights (see Resonance Rapid Fire), which stagger enemies over and over.

guide.context: There is no in-game counter, so plan a grinding session if you are short after the other achievements.

steps.text: Equip a Vision on each character that will use Resonances.
In battle, stagger every enemy in the same turn to trigger a Sweeping Stagger.
Attack in the bonus turn, then at its end choose a Resonance from one of your equipped Visions.

To grind faster, equip a Vision whose Resonance heals (such as Leah or Ayaka). Fight one enemy that staggers easily, then repeat: stagger it, use the Resonance to heal it, and Defend to pass the turn so it does not die.

achievements.description: Upgrade Mechabo to his ultimate form.
achievements.summary: Upgrade Mechabo to his final form through Verun's quests.

guide.context: The upgrades come from several quests, so the achievement does not unlock after the first upgrade.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, once the Mobliz Shipyard story events end, return to the @loc{Dwarven Forge}, speak with @npc{Verun} and take on "Arise, Mechabo!". Kill Ipooh bears outside the Forge until you hold two @item{Dynamo Stones}.

Take the "Mechabo Evolved" quest. In any order, hunt three Dhorme Chimerae near Grandport (north-east), three Medusae by the Dwarven Forge (south-west), three Destroyers in western Olderion Federation and three sandworms in southern Zoldaad.
Once Chapter 5 has begun, speak to Verun at the Forge to begin "Mechabo Unleashed". It asks for three Mahadevas killed on Mysidia's western island and three Malbodooms in western Gronoa.
steps.note: The Gronoa hunt is open from Chapter 6.

steps.text: Hand the parts to Verun inside the airship, not at the Forge. The quest completes and the achievement unlocks.

guide.context: Difficulty does not affect any achievement, so you can switch to Casual before this fight. The fight is a long battle of attrition.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 8 and reload your clear save. On the airship a short scene announces a new presence at Ardra Crater.
Fly to @loc{Ardra Crater} in the south-east and interact with @enemy{Ultima Weapon}. It is level 70 with about 3.9 million HP and is weak to Wind and Water.
steps.note: Level 60 is enough to win, though higher helps. Your setup and plan matter more than levels.

steps.text: A tested party, with every Vision maxed: Rain with Sephiroth, Fina with Ayaka, Archwitch Fina with Shantotto and Sakura with Terra.
Have Sakura and Archwitch Fina cast Dualcasted Ultima for damage while Rain attacks.
Spend Fina's first two turns on Dualcast, then Reraise for all four characters. After that, cure allies, cast Shellga, or Dispel Ultima Weapon's Bravery buff on itself.
Each heal fills Fina's Limit Break. When a bar is full, use Entrust to give it to Sakura. Before each Ultima Beam, use Sakura's Eternal Veil Limit Break to nullify all damage.
steps.note: Ultima Beam is its strongest move. Watch for an exclamation mark on the turn order bar plus red flames over its health bar.

steps.text: Ribbon accessories protect Fina and Archwitch Fina from most status ailments. Terra's ability protects Sakura. Rain is protected from Confuse only, so use Esuna or a Remedy for his other ailments.
